current_activity: The hard-pressed 272nd Volksgrenadier Division holds the Wahlerscheid-Simmerath sector
notes: Event date: CMH Ardennes ch. 5 p. 90: "counting on the hard-pressed 272d Volks Grenadier Division to hold in the Wahlerscheid-Simmerath sector so long as needed"; p. 103: "The bulk of the 272d Volks Grenadier Division, holding the sector, had been thrown in to stop the American 78th Division farther north". Event definition: the position at the opening of the offensive on 16 December; p. 103 describes the days that followed. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Simmerath with a precision of 10 km, one end of the Wahlerscheid-Simmerath sector. Location approximate: a town point at the sector end. Location support: CMH names the sector. Commander: unknown. Opponents: US V Corps (78th Infantry Division).

location_qualifier: front opposite the Remagen bridgehead; battalion-size Kampfgruppen
current_activity: Contingents of the 272d Volksgrenadier Division are opposite the Remagen bridgehead by 17 March
notes: Event date: CMH The Last Offensive ch. 11 p. 232: "By 17 March the German order of battle opposite the bridgehead sounded impressive on paper"; "the Germans had brought in contingents of the 26th, 62d, 272d, 277th, and 326th Volks Grenadier Divisions; the 3d and 5th Parachute Divisions; and the 3d Panzer Grenadier Division". Event definition: the situation by 17 March. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Remagen with a precision of 25 km, the bridgehead named; CMH gives battalion-size Kampfgruppen and no division position. Location approximate: a representative point for the front opposite the bridgehead. Location support: CMH names the front opposite the bridgehead. Commander: unknown. Opponents: US III and VII Corps. Context: CMH ch. 11 p. 232 calls all these contingents battalion-size Kampfgruppen or units filled out with inexperienced replacements.
